correctness.rationale: Main exact-value claims verify. Lemma 1 is sound: in a linear 3-graph each vertex link is a matching (pairwise intersections <=1 implies link pairs disjoint), so d(v)<=floor((n-1)/2)=4 for n=9,10, hence 3e=sum d<=n*4 and e<=floor(n*4/3)=12 (n=9), 13 (n=10). Independent replay of inputs/artifacts/verify.py PASSED: H9 linear, 36/36 pairs covered, degrees 4^9, max 7-span 5; H10 linear, 39/45 pairs covered, degrees 4^9 3^1, leave graph 6 edges with degrees 3^1 1^9 (K1,3 plus 3 disjoint edges as claimed), max 7-span 5. Fano criterion used (contains F iff some 7-set spans >=7 edges) is correct for linear hosts: F has 7 edges on 7 vertices; any 7 edges on 7 vertices in a linear host cover all 21 pairs exactly once, hence is an STS(7), unique up to iso as the Fano plane; pair bound caps linear 7-vertex graphs at 7 edges, so >=7 means exactly Fano, and <=6 means Fano-free. Threshold 6 vs observed 5 gives margin. Degree-sequence forcing is arithmetic: n=9 e=12 forces 4-regular (sum 36); hence pairwise-balanced STS(9); n=10 e=13 forces sum 39=40-1 with cap 4, hence 4^9 3^1; leave degrees 9-2d give 3^1 1^9. n=9 uniqueness up to iso correctly reduces to classical uniqueness of STS(9)=AG(2,3) after machine-checked forcing (citation-dependent, not re-proved). Deleting any edge preserves linearity and Fano-freeness, so E_n-1 attainable. Ancillary claim of >=2 non-isomorphic 13-edge max packings on n=10 is committed without a second edge list or log (witnesses.json has one H10 only) and is explicitly labelled computed evidence/open, so it is unevidenced but non-essential to E_n. Lagrangian replay is a vacuous restatement of the integer cap at uniform weights (L=e/n^3: 4/243, 13/1000), true but adding no independent bound. No essential inference or boundary condition fails; proof vs computation is honestly separated except the >=2-types remark.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors checked substantively and do not state or mechanically imply ex_lin(9,F)/ex_lin(10,F) with Fano-free witness. Bellmann-Reiher 1804.07673 proves unrestricted ex(n,F) for n>=8 is the balanced complete bipartite 3-graph, which contains repeated pairs and is inadmissible under linearity, so its numbers do not imply linear-restricted maxima. Gyarfas-Sarkozy 2011.13678 treats linear triangles/s-configurations/wicket and Ramsey in STS, no Fano-free linear maxima or 9-10 census. Hou-Liu-Zhang 2507.12354 treats large-n l2-norm bipartite extremality/stability, different norm and asymptotic regime, no small-order linear exact values. Structured arXiv API query all:"linear Turan" AND all:Fano returns totalResults 0, confirming no indexed title/abstract states the claim. Schoenheim pair-packing ceilings (12 for n=9, 13 for n=10) and STS(9) existence/uniqueness are classical but do not by themselves decide Fano-freeness or the Fano-restricted optimum; the 7-set span check (36/120 sets, max 5) was required. Method is textbook (degree cap = Schoenheim proof) but the combined factual statement with certified Fano-free witnesses is literally new. Hence PASS on novelty, narrowly, with value judged separately.

value.rationale: Even taking correctness and literal novelty as given, the result as delivered is not independently worth finding later. The upper bound uses no Fano hypothesis: it is the classical Schoenheim pair-packing bound for ANY linear 3-graph, so the Fano restriction is inert (ex_lin = max linear). Witnesses are classical designs: H9 is STS(9)=AG(2,3) covering all 36 pairs; H10 is a standard 13-triple maximum packing (degrees 4^9 3^1). The only non-textbook step is the 36/120 seven-set scan showing max span 5 <6, a seconds-scale check with margin, equivalent to noting the pair-optimal packings happen to have no Fano (STS(7)) subsystem. Promised advances beyond this — vertex-link Turan induction, substantive Lagrangian replay, per-order stability census with extremal-type counts and E_n-1 classification — were not delivered: n=10 iso-type count left open/conjectural, E_n-1 classification left open, >=2-types claim unevidenced, Lagrangian section restates the integer cap. Downstream uses as benchmark for Lagrangian/flag-algebra bounds and Brown-Erdos-Sos/stability conjectures are inflated because the bound is trivial pair-counting with no Fano-specific theory. This is a textbook restatement (Schoenheim + standard packings) plus a tiny inert-property check and an unexplained enumeration fragment, exactly the class value is meant to reject even if correct and new.
